mapper.select:
SELECT s.id, s.nick_name, s.real_name, s.head_image, s.campus_id, c.campus_name, s.major, s.education, s.grade, s.skills, s.experience, s.expected_salary, s.expected_location, ROUND( LEAST(100, (CASE WHEN s.major IS NOT NULL AND j.required_major IS NOT NULL AND ( j.required_major LIKE CONCAT('%', s.major, '%') OR s.major LIKE CONCAT('%', j.required_major, '%') ) THEN 35 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN s.skills IS NOT NULL AND j.required_skills IS NOT NULL AND ( j.required_skills LIKE CONCAT('%', s.skills, '%') OR s.skills LIKE CONCAT('%', j.required_skills, '%') ) THEN 35 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN s.education IS NOT NULL AND j.required_education IS NOT NULL AND s.education = j.required_education THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN s.expected_location IS NOT NULL AND j.work_location IS NOT NULL AND j.work_location LIKE CONCAT('%', s.expected_location, '%') THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) ), 0 ) AS match_score, CONCAT( CASE WHEN s.major IS NOT NULL AND j.required_major IS NOT NULL AND ( j.required_major LIKE CONCAT('%', s.major, '%') OR s.major LIKE CONCAT('%', j.required_major, '%') ) THEN '专业匹配、' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN s.skills IS NOT NULL AND j.required_skills IS NOT NULL AND ( j.required_skills LIKE CONCAT('%', s.skills, '%') OR s.skills LIKE CONCAT('%', j.required_skills, '%') ) THEN '技能匹配、' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN s.education IS NOT NULL AND j.required_education IS NOT NULL AND s.education = j.required_education THEN '学历匹配、' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN s.expected_location IS NOT NULL AND j.work_location IS NOT NULL AND j.work_location LIKE CONCAT('%', s.expected_location, '%') THEN '期望地点匹配' ELSE '' END ) AS match_reason, s.create_time, s.update_time FROM job j INNER JOIN student s ON s.status = 1 LEFT JOIN campus c ON s.campus_id = c.id WHERE j.id = #{jobId} AND j.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND j.status = 1 AND (j.expire_time IS NULL OR j.expire_time > NOW()) ORDER BY match_score DESC, CASE WHEN s.update_time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, s.update_time DESC, s.create_time DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
